Message:
clk: exynos5433: Fix CLK_PCLK_MONOTONIC_CNT clk register assignment

CLK_PCLK_MONOTONIC_CNT clock had a wrong register assigned to it.
The correct register is ENABLE_PCLK_MIF_SECURE_MONOTONIC_CNT.
